### Problem

What are you trying to do, and why can't you today?

### Proposal

What you would like to happen.

### Privacy impact (required)

Does this trade privacy for latency or convenience? What would it leak, and to whom?
Features that weaken privacy are gated (see PLAN.md section 0 and CONTRIBUTING.md).

### Alternatives

Anything you considered and rejected.
